settings.name: Dr. Mahnoor Khan (Islamabad)
settings.title: The bowed cage silhouette is pure art
settings.content: The curved, bulbous cage design is so unique and sculptural! The white marble with subtle grey veins looks so fresh and bright against our beige rug.

settings.name: Omer Siddiqui (Karachi)
settings.title: Crescent nesting base is genius
settings.content: The way the two side tables slide perfectly into the crescent cutouts of the main table is pure genius. Saves huge space in our apartment when we need floor room.

settings.name: Rabia Tahir (Lahore)
settings.title: Premium quality marble & flawless gold finish
settings.content: I was searching for a 3-piece white marble set for months in DHA Lahore. Gull e Gulzar's quality is on par with imported Turkish furniture at half the price.

settings.name: Khurram Shahzad (Rawalpindi)
settings.title: Solid, stable, and completely wobble-free
settings.content: The circular base rings have great balance. Even on thick carpet, none of the three tables wobble. The marble polish is water and stain resistant.

settings.name: Nida Yasir (Peshawar)
settings.title: Beautiful accent tables
settings.content: Very pleased with the purchase. The tables look even more luxurious in person than in pictures. WhatsApp customer support was very cooperative.

settings.name: Shehroz Alam (Sialkot)
settings.title: Exceeded all expectations
settings.content: The bowed wire styling gives it such a high-end designer vibe. Quick 4-day delivery to Sialkot with flawless packaging.

settings.name: Amina Bashir (Multan)
settings.title: Outstanding aesthetics
settings.content: Placed this in our formal drawing room and it draws compliments from everyone. Smooth edges, shiny white marble, and gorgeous gold.
